=WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO agent_tasks (client_id, lead_id, deal_ref, title, due_at, assigned_to, created_by)
  VALUES (
    '{{ $json.client_id }}',
    (SELECT id FROM leads WHERE id = NULLIF('{{ $json.lead_id }}', '')::uuid AND client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'),
    NULLIF('{{ $json.deal_ref }}', ''),
    '{{ $json.title }}',
    NULLIF('{{ $json.due_local }}', '')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago',
    NULLIF('{{ $json.assigned_to }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ $json.agent_email }}', '')
  )
  RETURNING id, title, deal_ref, assigned_to, due_at
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'added', true,
  'id', id,
  'title', title,
  'deal', deal_ref,
  'assigned_to', assigned_to,
  'due_central', to_char(due_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD HH24:MI')
) AS result
FROM ins

=SELECT json_build_object(
  'count', count(*),
  'tasks', coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)
) AS result
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.id,
    t.title,
    t.deal_ref AS deal,
    t.assigned_to,
    t.lead_id,
    to_char(t.due_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD HH24:MI') AS due_central,
    (t.status = 'open' AND t.due_at < now()) AS overdue,
    to_char(t.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD HH24:MI') AS completed_central
  FROM agent_tasks t
  WHERE t.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
    AND t.status = '{{ $json.status }}'
    AND ('{{ $json.assigned_to }}' = '' OR t.assigned_to ILIKE '{{ $json.assigned_to }}')
    AND ({{ $json.due_within_days }} < 0 OR t.due_at <
      (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date + {{ $json.due_within_days }} + 1)::timestamp
        AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'))
  ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST, t.due_at NULLS LAST, t.created_at
  LIMIT 50
) x

=WITH u AS (
  UPDATE agent_tasks
  SET status = 'done', completed_at = now()
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'
    AND client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
    AND status = 'open'
  RETURNING id, title, deal_ref
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'completed', (SELECT count(*) FROM u) > 0,
  'task', (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM u LIMIT 1),
  'note', CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM u) = 0
    THEN 'No open task with that id. It may already be done.' END
) AS result

=WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,
    CASE WHEN l.updated_at > l.created_at + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(l.last_contacted_at, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(l.nurture_enrolled_at, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(l.opted_out_at, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(CASE WHEN l.metadata->>'last_outreach_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
            THEN (l.metadata->>'last_outreach_at')::timestamptz END, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(CASE WHEN l.metadata->>'last_import_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
            THEN (l.metadata->>'last_import_at')::timestamptz END, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
    THEN l.updated_at END AS reengaged_at
  FROM leads l
  WHERE l.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
    AND l.status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified', 'nurturing')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    CASE
      WHEN b.reengaged_at >= now() - interval '{{ $json.days }} days' THEN 0
      WHEN b.created_at >= now() - interval '{{ $json.days }} days' THEN 1
      WHEN b.status = 'qualified'
        AND GREATEST(b.created_at, COALESCE(b.reengaged_at, b.created_at)) >= now() - interval '90 days' THEN 2
    END AS tier
  FROM base b
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'count', count(*),
  'leads', coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)
) AS result
FROM (
  SELECT
    r.id,
    r.lead_name,
    r.phone,
    r.email,
    CASE r.tier
      WHEN 0 THEN 'Active again ' || to_char(r.reengaged_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD')
        || ' (new inquiry or open house visit)'
      WHEN 1 THEN 'New lead ' || to_char(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD')
        || ' from ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(r.source, ''), 'unknown source')
      ELSE 'Qualified lead'
    END AS why,
    r.source,
    r.status,
    left(r.lead_message, 280) AS lead_message,
    r.metadata->>'property_address' AS property_address,
    r.metadata->>'price_range' AS price_range,
    r.email_opt_out,
    r.communication_opted_out AS marketing_email_opt_out,
    to_char(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD') AS came_in,
    to_char(r.last_contacted_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD') AS last_automated_email,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_tasks t WHERE t.lead_id = r.id AND t.status = 'open') AS open_tasks
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE r.tier IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY
    r.tier,
    (NULLIF(r.phone, '') IS NULL),
    COALESCE(r.reengaged_at, r.created_at) DESC
  LIMIT {{ $json.limit }}
) x

=WITH m AS (
  SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN l.updated_at > l.created_at + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(l.last_contacted_at, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(l.nurture_enrolled_at, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(l.opted_out_at, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(CASE WHEN l.metadata->>'last_outreach_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
            THEN (l.metadata->>'last_outreach_at')::timestamptz END, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
      AND l.updated_at > COALESCE(CASE WHEN l.metadata->>'last_import_at' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
            THEN (l.metadata->>'last_import_at')::timestamptz END, '-infinity') + interval '2 minutes'
    THEN l.updated_at END AS reengaged_at
  FROM leads l
  WHERE l.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
    AND (
      l.lead_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.q_like }}%' ESCAPE '\'
      OR l.email ILIKE '%{{ $json.q_like }}%' ESCAPE '\'
      OR l.metadata->>'property_address' ILIKE '%{{ $json.q_like }}%' ESCAPE '\'
      OR ('{{ $json.q_digits }}' <> ''
          AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%{{ $json.q_digits }}%')
    )
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'match_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM m),
  'note', CASE
    WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM m) = 0 THEN 'No lead matched. Try a last name, email, phone number or street.'
    WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM m) > 5 THEN 'More than 5 matches; showing the 5 most recent. Ask the agent for a last name, phone or address to narrow it down.'
  END,
  'leads', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x))
    FROM (
      SELECT
        l.id,
        l.lead_name,
        l.phone,
        l.email,
        l.source,
        l.status,
        left(l.lead_message, 500) AS lead_message,
        l.metadata->>'property_address' AS property_address,
        l.metadata->>'price_range' AS price_range,
        l.metadata->>'beds' AS beds,
        l.metadata->>'open_house_notes' AS open_house_notes,
        l.email_opt_out,
        l.communication_opted_out AS marketing_email_opt_out,
        to_char(l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD YYYY') AS came_in,
        to_char(l.reengaged_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD') AS active_again,
        to_char(l.nurture_enrolled_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD') AS nurture_started,
        to_char(l.last_contacted_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD') AS last_automated_email,
        (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
            'id', t.id,
            'title', t.title,
            'due_central', to_char(t.due_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Dy Mon DD HH24:MI')
          ) ORDER BY t.due_at NULLS LAST), '[]'::json)
         FROM agent_tasks t WHERE t.lead_id = l.id AND t.status = 'open') AS open_tasks,
        (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
            'what', CASE e.workflow_name
          WHEN 'instant_lead_response' THEN 'Sent an instant personalized reply'
          WHEN 'lead_response_auto' THEN 'Sent an instant personalized reply'
          WHEN 'open_house_follow_up' THEN 'Open house follow-up sent'
          WHEN 'open_house_follow_up_weichert' THEN 'Open house follow-up sent'
          WHEN 'nurture_deenroll_confirm' THEN 'Removed from nurture'
          WHEN 'marketing_opt_out' THEN 'Unsubscribed from marketing emails'
          WHEN 'weichert_offer_submit' THEN 'Offer submitted'
          ELSE e.workflow_name
        END,
            'when', to_char(e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD')
          ) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)
         FROM (
           SELECT we.workflow_name, we.created_at
           FROM workflow_events we
           WHERE (we.event_type = 'completed' OR we.workflow_name = 'lead_response_auto')
             AND (
               we.payload->>'lead_id' = l.id::text
               OR (we.client_id = l.client_id AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email <> ''
                   AND lower(COALESCE(we.payload->>'attendee_email', we.payload->>'buyer_email')) = lower(l.email))
             )
           ORDER BY we.created_at DESC
           LIMIT 10
         ) e) AS history
      FROM m l
      ORDER BY GREATEST(l.created_at, COALESCE(l.reengaged_at, l.created_at)) DESC
      LIMIT 5
    ) x
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS result

=WITH win AS (
  SELECT now() - interval '{{ $json.days }} days' AS since
),
nl AS (
  SELECT l.* FROM leads l, win
  WHERE l.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}' AND l.created_at >= win.since
),
ev AS (
  SELECT we.workflow_name, count(*) AS n
  FROM workflow_events we, win
  WHERE we.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
    AND we.event_type = 'completed'
    AND we.created_at >= win.since
  GROUP BY we.workflow_name
),
labels (workflow_name, label) AS (
  VALUES
    ('instant_lead_response', 'New leads sent an instant personalized reply'),
    ('lead_response_auto', 'New leads sent an instant personalized reply'),
    ('open_house_follow_up', 'Open house follow-ups sent'),
    ('open_house_follow_up_weichert', 'Open house follow-ups sent'),
    ('review_request', 'Review requests sent'),
    ('listing_description', 'Listing descriptions written'),
    ('research_agent', 'Property research reports'),
    ('bday_anniversary_outreach', 'Birthday and anniversary messages sent'),
    ('weichert_offer_submit', 'Offers received through your offer form'),
    ('agent_tools', 'Questions you asked your Norr AI assistant')
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'period', 'Last {{ $json.days }} days ('
    || to_char((SELECT since FROM win) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD') || ' to '
    || to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'Mon DD') || ')',
  'new_leads', (SELECT count(*) FROM nl),
  'new_leads_after_hours', (SELECT count(*) FROM nl
    WHERE extract(hour FROM created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 16
       OR extract(isodow FROM created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= 6),
  'new_leads_by_source', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('source', s, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC), '[]'::json)
    FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(source, ''), 'unknown') AS s, count(*) AS n FROM nl GROUP BY 1) x),
  'leads_started_on_nurture', (SELECT count(*) FROM leads l, win
    WHERE l.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}' AND l.nurture_enrolled_at >= win.since),
  'leads_sent_a_nurture_email', (SELECT count(*) FROM leads l, win
    WHERE l.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}' AND l.last_contacted_at >= win.since),
  'automations', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('what', label, 'count', total) ORDER BY total DESC), '[]'::json)
    FROM (SELECT lb.label, sum(ev.n) AS total FROM ev JOIN labels lb USING (workflow_name) GROUP BY lb.label) y),
  'tasks_completed', (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_tasks t, win
    WHERE t.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}' AND t.status = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= win.since),
  'note', 'Counts come from Norr AI logs for this agent only. The weekly listing email is office-wide and not included.'
) AS result
